scope: 26 data/action families and 9 page-pattern families; 42 runtime exports
evidencePolicy: Source/API applicability and runnable fixtures only; not browser or accessibility acceptance. Do not apply these narrowed scopes to deferred M2/M5 decisions.

DescriptionList.reason: items=[] yields an empty semantic list. There is no owned error state or error prop; rendering errors in a description value does not become a list error.

Timeline.reason: items=[] is supported. Failed events are ordinary event data, not a separate timeline loading/error API.

BarChart.reason: data=[] produces no bars; labels support long content. No owned request error state or error prop exists.

Statistic.reason: label and value are supplied presentation values. No empty/error lifecycle or state prop exists; negative trends do not imply a request error.

Meter.reason: A numeric value and range are required. Threshold danger tone is a measurement variant, not an empty/error request state.

Media.reason: src and alt are required. Native image/video errors do not produce an owned error fallback in this component; captions support long content.

Attachment.reason: disabled suppresses actions and downloading owns the download indicator. name supports long text; the component has no empty/error state API.

Avatar.reason: Invalid image data triggers the owned initials fallback. Missing src is the ordinary default, not an empty state; fixed-size initials do not render long names.

AvatarGroup.reason: No child avatars is a real empty group. Child Avatar image errors belong to Avatar; the group itself has no error or long-text presentation.

Badge.reason: count=0 and showZero=false hides the indicator. danger tone provides an explicit failure signal; content supports long visible text.

StatusIndicator.reason: Required label plus danger tone expresses a failure signal; the component does not own an empty-state contract.

Tag.reason: danger tone represents a failure label, long children are supported, and onRemove creates a real keyboard action. No dedicated empty state exists.

CodeBlock.reason: Existing code content already exercises long rendered source and real dark/locale hosts; there is no request lifecycle.

Card.reason: Card composes heading/description/body/footer with long content. Slot contents do not establish an owned request state.

OverflowText.reason: Overflow detection owns a keyboard-reachable tooltip. Public props expose only text and placement, with no disabled/readOnly/value/defaultValue/validation API.

ExpandableText.reason: Expansion is privately maintained by its own action. There is no public controlled/default-value/readOnly/disabled/validation contract.

List.reason: items=[] and empty content are public. List itself introduces no keyboard action; keyboard controls in items belong to those controls.

VirtualList.reason: items=[] has an empty region, long item values are rendered, and an overflowing fixed-height viewport exposes native keyboard scrolling. loadingMore gates end-reached calls without introducing a displayed loading state.

Toolbar.reason: The public toolbar groups start/main/end slots and preserves delegated keyboard actions. It has no disabled prop; child buttons own disable behavior.

FilterBar.reason: This is a form with fields, actions, activeFilters and status slots. Explicit local draft/submit filtering is demonstrated; loading/error/validation belong to nested controls, not an owned FilterBar state.

ClipboardButton.reason: Public disabled and label props plus the actual copy action are demonstrated. Private clipboard lifecycle is exercised by the ordinary interactive scene without inventing loading/error props.

SortableList.reason: items/onReorder is a controlled ordering contract, disabled suppresses moves and drag, items=[] is empty. There is no readOnly or validation API.

Tree.reason: Selection and expansion each support controlled/default props; node.disabled is real. nodes=[] and long node labels are supported. No readOnly/validation API exists.

Accordion.reason: value/defaultValue/onValueChange and item.disabled are public. items=[] and long item content are supported. No readOnly/validation API exists.

Collapse.reason: open/defaultOpen/onOpenChange and disabled are public. readOnly and validation are not supported.

Calendar.reason: Date selection supports value/defaultValue/onValueChange. isDateDisabled owns per-date availability; this is not a global disabled prop. No readOnly/validation API exists.

Scheduler.reason: date/onDateChange and events are supplied externally; events=[] and long event titles are supported. No disabled/readOnly/default date/validation API exists.

Gallery.reason: selectedId/onSelect supports controlled selection; items=[] has a public empty slot. No disabled/readOnly/validation API exists.

Carousel.reason: value/defaultValue/onValueChange, empty slides, and long slide content are public. There is no disabled/readOnly/validation API.

AuthenticationPage.reason: AuthenticationPage is a layout with identity, description and content slots; fields and submitted request states belong to its children.

FamilyLoginPage.reason: Owns credential validation, submitting status, rejected onSubmit feedback and products=[] unavailable state. Delayed/rejecting callbacks and blank-submit instructions demonstrate those states.

CreateEditPage.reason: submitDisabled and submitting own action availability/loading. Field validation, request error and empty content belong to supplied children.

DetailPage.reason: sections=[] is a genuine empty detail region; heading and sections support long text. The page has no owned fetch/error/validation lifecycle.

PageHeading.reason: Owns title/description and onBack action. Loading, validation and content emptiness are not heading states.

ListManagementPage.reason: This is a heading, filters, bulkActions, children and footer composition. Data loading/empty/error states belong to supplied result components.

SearchFilterPage.reason: Shares the list page composition; supplying an EmptyState or error child does not establish an owned page request state.

MemberManagementPage.reason: The fetchMembers result lifecycle owns loading/empty/error, while filters, sorting, paging and row actions are internal. There is no independent field validation contract.

SettingsPage.reason: currentId/onCurrentChange controls section selection; section.disabled is public; sections=[] leaves no active section. Child form errors/loading are not owned page states.

WizardFlow.reason: currentId/onStepChange controls navigation; nextDisabled and nextLoading own action states. Step content owns its own field errors and validation.

MasterDetail.reason: detailOpen=false switches to the explicit emptyDetail slot. Request loading/error/validation are not owned by this composition.

ImportExportPage.reason: importing/exporting explicitly control the pattern's own action indicators. It does not automatically await callbacks or own file validation/error/empty state.

StatusPage.reason: kind selects owned empty/error/permission/offline presentations. onRetry is an action callback, but StatusPage does not expose retryLoading or maintain pending state; therefore no loading claim.
